effect_description_eng:
[Security] [Opponent's Turn] All of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] For each of your face-up security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Royal Base] trait Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, by flipping your top face-up security card face down, 1 of those Digimon doesn't leave.
